Package com.lemarketjames.market.model

package com.lemarketjames.market.model
Immutable market types and the pricing maths, free of Spring and of any mutable state so they can be unit tested directly: the GBM formulas (GbmModel), trading hours, an instrument's definition, a price snapshot, and a completed candle.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    com.lemarketjames.market
    Simulated stock market: the platform's source of current prices (BR-08, BR-12, BR-13).
    com.lemarketjames.market.config
    Configuration for the market feature: the sim.* properties, the UTC clock bean, and scheduling, which is enabled only when sim.enabled is true so tests have no background threads moving prices.
    com.lemarketjames.market.entity
    JPA persistence layer for the market feature: simulation parameters per instrument, the latest price snapshot per instrument, and 1-minute OHLC candles (database/schema/006_market_simulation.sql).
    com.lemarketjames.market.repository
    Spring Data repositories for the market feature's tables.
    com.lemarketjames.market.service
    The running market: the simulator that advances prices, the scheduler that drives it, database loading/saving, and the read-only MarketDataService other features depend on.
  • Class
    Description
    GbmModel
    Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) price math.
    MarketHours
    Trading hours for a market, used to decide when an instrument's price may move and how long a "trading year" is for the GBM time step.
    MarketInstrument
    Immutable definition of a simulated instrument: its identity from instruments plus its simulation settings from instrument_market_params.
    PriceCandle
    A completed 1-minute OHLC (open/high/low/close) bar, ready to be stored in price_candles.
    QuoteSnapshot
    Immutable point-in-time view of an instrument's price.
